description.value: 10 Acres Bistro is a farm-to-table restaurant in downtown Victoria, part of the 10 Acres Farm & Restaurants group that operates four distinct dining locations across Greater Victoria and Sidney. The restaurant draws directly from its own farm, giving cyclists stopping in the city a chance to enjoy locally sourced, seasonally driven meals. Its central Courtney Street location makes it a convenient stop on a ride through downtown Victoria.
